PlayerToggleDefault.Name: Allow players by default
PlayerToggleDefault.Hint: Allow players to turn new lights on and off.

DefaultSwitchIcon.Name: Default switch icon
DefaultSwitchIcon.Hint: Choose an image or GIF for new lights. Leave blank to use the default switch.

ShowForGM.Name: Show switches to GMs
ShowForGM.Hint: Show switches when logged in as a GM.

LimitInteractionDistance.Name: Limit interaction range
LimitInteractionDistance.Hint: Require a controlled token within range to use a switch.

InteractionDistance.Hint: Set the range from 0 to 20 grid squares. The default is 5.

DistanceAffectsGM.Name: Apply range limit to GMs
DistanceAffectsGM.Hint: Apply the same limit to GMs when they control a token.

SwitchIcon.Label: Switch icon
SwitchIcon.Hint: Choose an image or GIF. Leave blank to use the default switch.

PlayerToggleEnabled.Label: Allow players to use this switch
PlayerToggleEnabled.Hint: Allow players to turn this light and all connected lights on or off.

Circuits.Description: Connect lights so they switch on and off together.
